:::{#exr-independent-null-space-practice}
#### Testing independent columns through the null space

@thm-independent-null-space turns a question about independence into one about solving $\matr{A}\vecf{x} = \vzero$.
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{1 & 2 \\ 2 & 4 \\ 0 & 1}.
$$

Decide whether the [columns of $\matr{A}$](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-column) are [linearly independent](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-linearly-independent).

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Solve $\matr{A}\vecf{x} = \vzero_3$, starting with the third entry.

:::

:::
